section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: INSPECTION OF THEFT DETERRENT HORN CIRCUIT

content.text: INSPECTION OF THEFT DETERRENT HORN CIRCUIT

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for theft deterrent horn circuit inspection. Starts with turning ignition switch off, then checks HAZ fuse, with branches for Yes/No responses leading to different diagnostic steps including fuse replacement, checking for short circuits, and fuse fault diagnosis.

branches.No: Short circuit in wire harness between fuse and terminal 1 of theft deterrent horn.

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for theft deterrent horn system. Contains three main inspection blocks: INSPECT POWER SOURCE, INSPECT HORN OPERATION (with reference to page BE-100), and INSPECT HORN CIRCUIT. Each block has Yes/No decision paths leading to specific repair actions including replacing horn, checking for open circuits, or replacing computer.

steps.title: INSPECT POWER SOURCE
steps.text: Disconnect connector from horn. Is there battery voltage between terminal 1 of connector side and body ground?

branches.No: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 1 of horn and fuse.

steps.title: INSPECT HORN CIRCUIT
steps.text: Disconnect connector from horn and computer. Is there continuity between terminal 2 of horn side connector and terminal 12 of computer side connector?

branches.No: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 12 of computer and terminal 2 of horn.
